rules.title: const constructors
rules.text: Use const constructors and widgets wherever possible.

rules.title: Small widgets
rules.text: Split large build methods into small widgets, not helper methods.

rules.title: dart analyze and format
rules.text: Keep dart analyze clean and format with dart format.

rules.title: One state solution
rules.text: Use a single state management approach consistently across the app.

rules.title: Keys for lists
rules.text: Provide keys for stateful items in dynamic lists.

rules.title: Check mounted after await
rules.text: Check context.mounted after awaits before using BuildContext.

rules.title: Theme over hardcoding
rules.text: Take colors and text styles from Theme instead of hardcoding them.

rules.title: Widget and golden tests
rules.text: Cover widgets with widget tests and golden tests for visual states.
